999008199.text: 素材も集まったし、ここからはアタシの見せ場！

localizations.en: We've got all the materials—now it's time to show you what I'm made of!

999008199.text:
今日は初めてのお客様もいるし、
いつもより多めに回しちゃいますわ！

localizations.en: We've got a first-timer with us today, so I'm going all-out—even more than usual!

999008199.text: 錬金術は素人だけど、多めに回して大丈夫なの？

localizations.en: I don't know much about alchemy, but is doing 'more than usual' actually okay?

999008199.text:
そこは錬金術士の腕の見せどころっす！
あと１時間ちょっとやるだけで

localizations.en: This is where the skill of the alchemist really shines! Just give me a little over an hour and—

999008199.text:
１時間はびっくりだわ。錬金術って、忍耐なのね……
レスナも、それができてるってことよね

localizations.en: An hour?! So alchemy is just... patience? No wonder Resna stuck with it...

999008199.text: ええと、これでも短いほうなんすけども……

localizations.en: Actually, an hour's pretty short for this kind of thing...

999008199.text:
クレオは昔から一つ所に留まらないことには
定評があったからね

localizations.en: Creo's always had a reputation for never staying in one place for long.

999008199.text:
それはリヒャルト兄さんも同じだと思うけど？
っていうかいたんだ？

localizations.en: Sounds a lot like someone else I know. Wait—were you here this whole time?

999008199.text:
いたよ、ちょっと前から！
メーヴェさんが合流したって知らせがあったから！

localizations.en: I've been here a while! I heard word that Mowen had joined the group, so I came to see!

999008199.text: 兄が、妹に舐められてる……

localizations.en: ...An older brother, being talked down to by his little sister.

999008199.text: とっても仲がいい兄妹ね

localizations.en: What a wonderfully close pair of siblings.

999008199.text:
軽口が叩き合えるのも、家族の形の１つかもね。
レスナは大人しかったわよ～

localizations.en: Being able to tease each other like that—that's what family is all about. Resna was much quieter, honestly.

999008199.text: そうだったんですか？

そうか、アルビーナは昔のレスナを知らないか。
おのぼりさんだった頃の彼女から見違えたからなぁ

localizations.en: Right, you never knew Resna back then. She's come such a long way from when she first arrived in the capital—wide-eyed and overwhelmed.

999008199.text:
私も今のレスナを知らないから、
会うのが楽しみなのよね～

localizations.en: And I still haven't seen the Resna she's become. I can't wait to meet her.

999008199.text:
そういえば、お母さんとはもう何年も会ってないって
レスナが言ってたような

localizations.en: Actually... I think Resna mentioned she hadn't seen you in years.

999008199.text:
ええ。ウェルテックスとの戦いで行方不明になった
愛しのユリウス……旦那を探して旅していたの

localizations.en: That's right. My dear Julius—my husband—went missing during the battle with Weltex. I've been traveling ever since, trying to find him.

999008199.text:
彼を探して幾数年……十数年かな？
もう結構長くなるわ

localizations.en: Searching for him all these years... it's been over a decade at this point. The time really adds up.

999008199.text:
多分大陸の南西地域にいるんじゃないかなって
うろうろしてたんだけど、空振りばかりでね

localizations.en: I had a feeling he might be somewhere in the southwestern regions, so I was wandering around out there—but kept coming up empty.

999008199.text:
危険地帯の南西地域をうろうろって……
南辺境を守ってた私からすると信じられないんだけど

localizations.en: Wandering around the southwestern danger zones... as someone who used to guard the southern border, I find that hard to believe.

999008199.text:
そこはほら！　冒険者だし？
で、放浪してたら聞こえてきたわけよ

localizations.en: Well, hey—adventurer, remember? Anyway, while I was out there, word started reaching me.

999008199.text:
頂獣を倒した錬金術士がいる。
その名はレスナ・シュテルネンリヒト……って

localizations.en: An alchemist who defeated an Apexi. Her name: Resna Sternenlicht.

999008199.text:
それ、もう１年以上前の出来事なんだけどね。
王国領ではない地域には情報が伝わるのが遅いから

localizations.en: That was over a year ago, for what it's worth. News travels slowly to regions outside the kingdom.

999008199.text:
で、レスナはどうしてるんだろうと思って
里帰りしたら実家にだーれもいない！

localizations.en: So I figured I'd swing by home to see how she was doing—and there was nobody there!

999008199.text:
ココシュカさん家で王都に行ったって聞いたから
向かってみたら、ロマンさんと出会ったの

localizations.en: The Kokoschkas told me she'd gone to the capital, so I headed there and ran into Roman.

999008199.text:
こっちは九偉人のヘルトとゼロの対策を練っていてね。
レスナたちは大変な目にあっているはずだろう？

localizations.en: I've been trying to figure out what to do about Held and Zero from the Miraculous Nine. Resna and the others are in serious trouble, after all.

999008199.text:
援軍はいくらあってもいい、そう思って事情を話して
メーヴェさんにも神聖国まで来てもらったんだ

localizations.en: More reinforcements are always welcome. I explained the situation, and asked Mowen to come with us to Nova.

999008199.text:
なるほど……１０年以上会ってないお母さんが
助けに来たって知ったら、レスナ喜ぶだろうな～

localizations.en: I see... Resna's going to be so happy when she finds out her mom came all this way to help. After more than ten years apart...

999008199.text:
だといいけど……ねえ、今のあの子って、
あなたたちから見てどういう錬金術士かしら？

localizations.en: I hope so... Tell me—as people who know her now, what kind of alchemist is she?

999008199.text: まずは……本が好きで難しい単語をよく知ってる

localizations.en: For starters... she loves books. She always knows difficult words.

999008199.text: なるほどね、確かに昔から本の虫だった

localizations.en: Ha. That tracks—she was always buried in a book growing up.

999008199.text:
そして強い意志を持った、とても優しい子ですよ。
夢を追い、巨大な敵と戦っています

localizations.en: She's kind, and she's got a will of iron. She chases her dreams and stands up to impossible odds.

999008199.text: そう……強さは私譲り、優しさはユリウス譲りね

localizations.en: I see... The strength is mine, and the kindness is Julius's.

999008199.text:
直接の面識はないけれど、諸国の問題を解決し
この無数島群域でも知られる英雄って聞いてるよ

localizations.en: I've never met her myself, but from what I've heard, she's solved problems all over the world—a hero known even out here in the Infinite Island Chain.

999008199.text:
とても、いい仲間に恵まれていると思うわ。
その点は安心してもらって大丈夫

localizations.en: She's found herself wonderful companions. On that front, you can rest easy.

999008199.text:
いやあほんと、親はなくとも子は育つというか、
私を反面教師にしてるのかも？

localizations.en: Ha... I guess kids turn out fine even without their parents around. Maybe she learned everything from my bad example.

999008199.text:
……アタシにとっては、困ったときに
そっと助けてくれる……とっても頼りになる、先輩です

localizations.en: ...To me, she's someone who quietly shows up when things get hard. Someone I can truly count on. She's a wonderful senior alchemist.

999008199.text:
そっか、しっかり先輩やれてるのね。
あの引っ込み思案だったレスナが……

localizations.en: So she really has grown into that role. The same shy little girl who used to hide behind me...

999008199.text:
私の知ってるレスナは幼くて、
恋も、親への反抗もまだだった

localizations.en: The Resna I knew was still so young—no first love, no rebellious phase, none of that.

999008199.text:
託せる人がいたとはいえ、夫を探すために
ほったらかしで家を飛び出して……酷い母親だけど

localizations.en: I left her behind to go look for her father. Walked out the door and didn't come back. Not exactly mother of the year...

999008199.text:
私とユリウスの自慢の子……レスナをありがとう。
そしてこれからも、どうかよろしくお願いします

localizations.en: But she's mine and Julius's greatest pride. Thank you for looking after her—and please, take care of her from here on too.
